// @env node
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import process from 'node:process'

async function main() {
  const { argument, defineCommand } = await import('argvia')
  const { runMain } = await import('argvia/node')
  let action
  const command = defineCommand({
    args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
    run({ args }) {
      action = args.action
    },
  })

  await runMain(command)
  assert.equal(action, 'ready')
  assert.equal(process.exitCode, 0)
  process.stdout.write('进程入口消费通过\n')
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})
